bullets: The command-line assistant now shows empty ad slots when the service withholds ads instead of repeating old ones.
The assistant now hides its internal bookkeeping steps but keeps other actions visible and folded into a single line.
The system now labels failed or refused turns in conversation history to prevent resending that content on the next step.
The connection monitor now checks for internet recovery while the assistant is actively working instead of waiting for the task to end.
Skill commands now include the saved task guide's folder location so the assistant finds its supporting files more reliably.
The assistant can now read files in folders usually hidden from its background scanning when you ask for them by name.
A new public data-use answer clarifies that Freebuff does not read files outside your project except for a few listed exceptions.
Ad preview images now load only from the secure image servers of the platform where the post was made.
A new model called MiniMax M3.1 Flash was added to the list of free options in the coding assistant.
The internal admin dashboard now pulls its user, project, and platform statistics directly from the primary database.
The identity verification system now pulls information directly from the new database instead of using side-by-side comparisons.
The backend settings for project error logs and cloud preview controls now read and write data in the primary database.
Error reports now hide sensitive details like security codes stored when linking accounts to external services.
